Women’s sport: anatomy of an accelerating market

Deloitte’s published revenue estimates show a growing market. What these figures tell us — and what they cannot tell us about investment value.

  • Deloitte estimates 2025 revenue at US$2.41bn.
  • The 2026 forecast is US$3.04bn, not a realised result.
  • Revenue growth alone does not establish undervaluation.
